name: Fluvoxamine Maleate
sections: White crystalline powder (maleate), sparingly soluble in water.

The first SSRI approved by the US FDA for obsessive-compulsive disorder and the first registered for paediatric OCD (1997). First approval/introduction: Introduced in Switzerland 1983 (Kali-Duphar/Solvay); US FDA 1994 for OCD.

Selective inhibitor of serotonin reuptake with additional sigma-1 receptor agonism; used for depression and obsessive-compulsive disorder. Receptor / target profile: Selective SERT inhibitor (Ki 2.5 nM) with ~100-fold selectivity over NET; the highest sigma-1 receptor affinity of the SSRIs (agonist, Ki 36 nM).
Summary: Well absorbed; Tmax 3–8 h. ~77% protein bound. Extensively metabolised in liver. Half-life ~15–20 h. Potent inhibitor of CYP1A2 and CYP2C19; moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor.
Depression: start 50–100 mg at bedtime; usual 100 mg/day, max 300 mg/day (divide doses >150 mg)
OCD: start 50 mg at bedtime, increase by 50 mg every 4–7 days to 100–300 mg/day
Controlled release: 100 mg once daily at bedtime, increase by 50 mg weekly; max 300 mg/day
CR tablets must be swallowed whole
Dose to be individualised by the treating physician according to clinical response and tolerability.
Approved for OCD from 8 years (max 200 mg/day in children).
Excreted in small amounts in milk; use with caution.
Concomitant tizanidine, thioridazine, pimozide, alosetron, ramelteon
Tizanidine, theophylline, clozapine, olanzapine, caffeine (CYP1A2 – levels raised)
With or without food; reduce caffeine (CYP1A2 inhibition raises caffeine levels); avoid alcohol.
Mood/suicidality; levels/effects of co-administered CYP1A2 substrates (theophylline, clozapine, warfarin INR).
GI disturbance, somnolence, dizziness, tachycardia/bradycardia, seizures, coma. Supportive care; activated charcoal.
Goodman et al., Arch Gen Psychiatry 1989 and later trials – efficacy in OCD.
Riddle et al., JAACAP 2001 – efficacy and safety in paediatric OCD.
Investigated for COVID-19 (TOGETHER trial, Lancet Global Health 2022) – not an approved indication.
Limit tea/coffee – caffeine effects may increase
Inform all prescribers – many drug interactions
Store below 30°C in a dry place, protected from light and moisture. Keep out of the reach of children. Do not use after the expiry date.
